queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE addresses(record) AS (SELECT MIN(record) FROM record_actions WHERE account = ? UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT MIN(record) FROM record_actions WHERE account = ? AND record > addresses.record) FROM addresses WHERE record IS NOT NULL) SELECT record, (SELECT a.rowid FROM record_actions a WHERE a.account = ? AND a.record = addresses.record AND a.sequence <= COALESCE((SELECT sequence FROM record_coverage WHERE account = a.account AND replica = a.author), 0) ORDER BY a.rowid LIMIT 1) AS first_applied FROM addresses WHERE record IS NOT NULL AND first_applied IS NOT NULL ORDER BY first_applied
